The Land · Campaign coming soon

Paititi Biocultural Reserve

1,516 hectares where the high Andes give way to cloud forest, held as a buffer to the Manu National Park Reserve, with the title affirmed in 2026. A campaign to maintain the reserve is being prepared.

Amazon · Campaign open

Support the Growth of the Yahua Ancestral School and Living Wisdom Center

In the heart of the Peruvian Amazon, the first Yahua Ancestral School maloca now stands complete, brought into being entirely through the proceeds from Beyond Ayahuasca. Your gift builds the campus around it: five dieta huts where youth can experience rites of passage guided by their elders, compostable bathrooms, solar-powered water systems, a curriculum that carries ancestral stories and the teachings of the living forest, and wisdom keepers brought from deeper Yahua communities.

Andes · Campaign open

An Ancestral School for the Q’ero Nation

What began in the Amazon with the Yahua Ancestral School is now extending to the Andes. Your gift helps develop an ancestral school for the Q’ero Nation: a dedicated physical space for elder-to-youth transmission, preservation of the Quechua language and ceremonial knowledge, land-based education rooted in Andean ecology, intergenerational workshops for children and families, and infrastructure that supports community stability beyond tourism-based income. The school is dedicated to the memory of Q’ero elder Pampamesayoq Juan Gabriel Apaza Lunasco.

Good to know

How your gift travels

Zeffy charges no platform fees, so your offering moves directly into the initiative you choose. Paititi Institute is registered in Peru and fiscally sponsored in the United States by Empowerment WORKS, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, so donations through Zeffy are tax-deductible in the United States.

There are other ways to walk with us. 100% of Roman Hanis’ author royalties from Beyond Ayahuasca support Paititi Institute’s Indigenous education and cultural preservation initiatives, and for twenty years, proceeds from our retreats have funded every nonprofit initiative at Paititi.
